reason: The 10-K filing does not contain any Total Addressable Market (TAM) disclosure from Boot Barn Holdings, Inc. The company discusses its participation in 'the large, growing and highly fragmented western, country lifestyle and work wear markets' and mentions growth drivers, but provides no quantified TAM figure, market size estimate, or addressable market valuation. The company only discloses operational metrics such as store count (459 stores with potential to grow to 900 stores domestically) and customer loyalty program membership (9.6 million members), but does not quantify the total market opportunity in dollar terms or other units.
